description: Replies to a review from ploa_reviews_get (reviewId such as apple:123 or google:abc), in the store, under the review, where anyone can read it. A new reply replaces the one there was. Empty text takes the App Store reply back (Google Play can't). At most 5970 characters on the App Store and 350 on Google Play. Write it as the app's developer: thank, answer the point, no promises the team hasn't made. From an agent it waits for a person's approval (needs a token allowed to submit).

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_review_reply
title: Reply to a customer review
